## Hypothesis

We are assessing whether the top keeper from the shotgun_scalper_stage5 parameter sweep (edge_capture=506.55, wide_pnl=22084.2, WR=0.576) represents a genuine edge suitable for promotion to the leaderboard. The edge_capture is below the OP-16 rejection floor of 771 (50% of max possible 1542), suggesting it may not meet the minimum threshold for J's edge capture regardless of other metrics.

## Mechanism

The keeper uses these parameters:
- `tp_premium_pct`: 0.75 (exit 2/3 position at +75% premium gain)
- `stop_premium_pct`: -0.35 (catastrophe stop at -35% premium)
- `time_stop_min`: 12 (exit after 12 minutes if no stop/TP hit)
- `strike_offset`: 2 (trades OTM-2 strikes based on params.json convention)
- `chandelier_arm_pct`: 0.6 (profit lock arms at +60% premium, trails 15% from HWM)
- `vol_ratio_threshold`: 1.2 (requires volume ≥1.2x 20-bar average for entry)

Entry triggers on the first bar meeting volume threshold; exits use the first of TP, catastrophic stop, or time stop.
